provisioning_notes: All 18 records are design proposals only; native_active remains false and native_ids_admitted is false for every candidate.

Preparation, forging or weaving, tempering, signature finishing, and inspection and attunement are five required meaningful stages; a city maker, funded inputs, actual craft and delivery, and equip validation are required; early records are not usable final legendary equipment.
Every ammunition, charge, repair input, barrier cell, and support payload is a real stocked input. No free or infinite charges are implied.

Bots choose from actual demand and compatible forms. They use normal equipment when a normal route exists and refuse devices requiring an unavailable profession, class, slot, ammo route, client form, or native effect route.
Commissioned engineering remains valuable to non-engineers only through admitted normal equipment forms; profession and class restrictions are never rewritten.

Stat priorities are bounded allocations within field, masterwork, or legendary role budgets. They do not add uncapped boss legacies or assert numbers, item IDs, spell IDs, damage, duration, range, chance, or cooldown.

Defensive barriers, deployables, controlled explosions, and support devices require native target, hostility, range, cooldown, client presentation, friendly-protection, and clean-removal validation. No forced arrivals or invulnerable bodyguards are allowed.

The first live pilot should prove one useful ranged or barrier form with funded real inputs, a city maker, actual craft and delivery provenance, save/load/mail/equip behavior, observed bounded effect, and clean removal before expanding the catalogue.
